name: Prospecting
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: bendingbtw
description:
Prospecting is a new enchantment that turns everyday tool use into XP.
Put it on a pickaxe, shovel, axe or hoe, and breaking natural blocks with the right tool drops normal XP orbs at that spot.
